dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is Songkran a public holiday?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn ə ˌpʌblɪk ˈhɑːlədeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. It's a three-day holiday in April.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ə ˌθriː ˌdeɪ ˈhɑːlədeɪ ɪn ˈeɪprəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In Canada, our big holiday is at Christmas.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈkænədə, aʊər ˈbɪɡ ˈhɑːlədeɪ ɪz ət ˈkrɪsməs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Christmas is on December twenty-fifth, right?
dialogue.reading: ˈkrɪsməs ɪz ɑːn dɪˈsɛmbər ˌtwɛnti ˈfɪfθ, ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's right. And New Year's Day is on January first.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ənd ˌnuː jɪrz ˈdeɪ ɪz ɑːn ˈdʒænjuɛri ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Do you have a long weekend in January, too?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈhæv ə ˌlɔːŋ ˈwiːkɛnd ɪn ˈdʒænjuɛri, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sometimes. When New Year's Day is on a Monday, we have a long weekend.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. wɛn ˌnuː jɪrz ˈdeɪ ɪz ɑːn ə ˈmʌndeɪ, wiː ˈhæv ə ˌlɔːŋ ˈwiːkɛnd.
